input: A local original file (read only) and the destination file in the project folder.
output: An H.264 High 8-bit 4:2:0 QuickTime copy: same size, every frame (passthrough), key frame every 10 pictures, no B frames, about 35 Mbit/s; every sound stream copied bit for bit; timecode and metadata from the original. Encoder: the first of this OS that passes a test encode (Windows: Intel QSV, NVIDIA NVENC, AMD AMF, libx264; macOS: VideoToolbox, libx264; Linux: NVENC, QSV, libx264); no other encoder is tried after a failure. Runs below normal priority.
specification: User decisions 2026-10-09 (XAVC 4:2:2 on laptops without RTX 50; standard formats only; export from the original); v5 qnc-media-ffmpeg/src/proxy.rs.
